nl: Run tools/greet.py with the argument Bob and the environment variable GREETING set to 'Hi' and APP_MODE set to 'batch'; save its output to greet-3.txt. Do not store the variables in any file.

entries.content_utf8:
import os
import sys

print(f"{os.environ['GREETING']}, {sys.argv[1]}")
print(f"mode={os.environ.get('APP_MODE', 'default')}")

reference_bash: GREETING='Hi' APP_MODE=batch python3 tools/greet.py Bob > greet-3.txt
reference_pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
$env:GREETING = 'Hi'
$env:APP_MODE = 'batch'
& $py tools/greet.py Bob | Set-Content greet-3.txt
